articles.title: Aden Airport Resumes Operations After Houthi Shelling
articles.description: ADEN-SABA Aden International Airport resumed operations Thursday following a temporary suspension caused by Houthi shelling on Wednesday, Transport Minister Mohsen al-Omari announced. Al-Omari inspected emergency runway repairs and said flight schedules had been revised, with airlines notified to resume flights to and from the airport. He condemned the attacks on the civilian facility and affirmed that public services would continue despite repeated strikes.
